name: filename-field
title: File name field
description: Rename a file without breaking it: the name is editable, the extension stays fixed beside it and forbidden characters are explained.
docs: value and onValueChange(name, { valid }) speak the whole name, extension included. The input holds the name only; the extension sits behind it as a fixed part of the field (.tar.gz and its kin stay together) and is put back on the reported name. Focusing the field selects the name. Characters a file name cannot hold (/ \ : * ? " < > | and control characters) are refused with the reason in words (Names cannot contain a slash (/)), spaces at the start are dropped and spaces at the end are trimmed when the field is left, and typing or pasting the extension again is caught. taken lists the names that exist; a match (capitals ignored) is flagged with aria-invalid and the next free name is offered (Use report (2).pdf). maxLength counts the whole name. extensionEditable gives the extension a box of its own and warns while it differs from the one it started with. The box stays whatever it holds: it is sized to its text, a lone dot is kept while it has the focus (so deleting an extension down to its dot does not empty it), and an empty box shows its .ext placeholder, so an extension can be typed back or added to a name that had none. name posts the whole name in a hidden input, labels renames every phrase.
